import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, LogisticRegression, Ridge, Lasso
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, export_text
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, KFold, GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.ensemble import VotingClassifier

X = np.array([[1.0, 5.0], [2.0, 3.0], [3.0, 6.0], [4.0, 2.0], [5.0, 8.0], [6.0, 1.0], [7.0, 7.0], [8.0, 4.0], [9.0, 9.0], [10.0, 0.5], [11.0, 6.5], [12.0, 2.5]])
y = np.array([3.1, 4.9, 7.2, 8.8, 11.1, 12.7, 15.2, 16.9, 19.3, 20.8, 23.1, 24.7])
c = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1])

m = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
print(np.round(m.coef_, 4), round(m.intercept_, 4), round(m.score(X, y), 4), np.round(m.predict(X[:2]), 3))
r = Ridge(alpha=1.0).fit(X, y)
print(np.round(r.coef_, 4), round(r.intercept_, 4))
l = Lasso(alpha=1.0).fit(X, y)
print(np.round(l.coef_, 3), round(l.intercept_, 3))
lg = LogisticRegression().fit(X, c)
print(np.round(lg.coef_, 2), np.round(lg.intercept_, 2), lg.predict(X), np.round(lg.predict_proba(X[:2]), 2), lg.score(X, c))
t = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=2, random_state=0).fit(X, c)
print(t.predict(X), t.score(X, c), t.get_depth(), np.round(t.feature_importances_, 3), t.get_n_leaves())
print(export_text(t, feature_names=['a', 'b']))
t2 = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0).fit(X, c)
print(t2.get_depth(), t2.score(X, c))
k = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3).fit(X, c)
print(k.predict(np.array([[3.5, 4.0], [9.5, 3.0]])), k.score(X, c))
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, c, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
print(Xtr.shape, Xte.shape, ytr, yte, Xte)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, c, test_size=3, random_state=0)
print(yte, ytr)
a, b = train_test_split(np.arange(10), test_size=0.3, random_state=1)
print(a, b)
a, b = train_test_split(np.arange(10), test_size=0.3, shuffle=False)
print(a, b)
print(np.round(cross_val_score(DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=0), X, c, cv=3), 4))
print(np.round(cross_val_score(LinearRegression(), X, y, cv=3), 4))
print(np.round(cross_val_score(KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=1), X, c, cv=KFold(n_splits=4)), 4))
for tr, te in KFold(n_splits=3).split(X):
    print(tr, te)
for tr, te in KFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=0).split(X):
    print(tr, te)
for tr, te in StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3).split(X, c):
    print(tr, te)
g = GridSearchCV(DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0), {'max_depth': [1, 2, 3]}, cv=3).fit(X, c)
print(g.best_params_, round(g.best_score_, 4))
yt = np.array([1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0])
yp = np.array([1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0])
print(accuracy_score(yt, yp), precision_score(yt, yp), recall_score(yt, yp), f1_score(yt, yp))
print(confusion_matrix(yt, yp))
print(roc_auc_score(yt, np.array([0.9, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 0.5, 0.7, 0.3, 0.1])))
print(mean_squared_error(y, y + 1), mean_absolute_error(y, y + 2), round(r2_score(y, y + 1), 4))
s = StandardScaler().fit(X)
print(np.round(s.mean_, 3), np.round(s.scale_, 3), np.round(s.transform(X[:2]), 3))
print(np.round(MinMaxScaler().fit_transform(X[:3]), 3))
p = PCA(n_components=2).fit(X)
print(np.round(p.explained_variance_ratio_, 4), np.round(p.explained_variance_, 3), np.round(np.abs(p.components_), 4))
pts = np.array([[1.0, 1.0], [1.5, 2.0], [1.0, 1.5], [8.0, 8.0], [8.5, 9.0], [9.0, 8.0]])
km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, init=np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [10.0, 10.0]]), n_init=1).fit(pts)
print(km.labels_, np.round(km.cluster_centers_, 3), round(km.inertia_, 3), km.predict(np.array([[0.0, 1.0]])))
v = VotingClassifier(estimators=[('a', DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=0)), ('b', KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3)), ('c', LogisticRegression())]).fit(X, c)
print(v.predict(X), v.score(X, c))

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from scipy.stats import norm, binom, poisson, t, chi2, f
def r(x, n=6):
    return round(float(x), n)
print(r(norm.cdf(1.96)), r(norm.pdf(0)), r(norm.ppf(0.975)), r(norm.cdf(70, 60, 10)), r(norm.sf(1.0)), r(norm.ppf(0.5, 50, 5)), r(norm.mean(50, 5)), r(norm.std(50, 5)), r(norm.isf(0.05)))
print(r(binom.pmf(3, 10, 0.5)), r(binom.cdf(3, 10, 0.5)), r(binom.sf(3, 10, 0.5)), r(binom.mean(10, 0.3)), r(binom.var(10, 0.3)), r(binom.std(10, 0.3)))
print(r(poisson.pmf(2, 3)), r(poisson.cdf(2, 3)), r(poisson.sf(2, 3)), r(poisson.mean(3)), r(poisson.var(3)))
print(r(t.cdf(2.0, 10)), r(t.ppf(0.975, 10)), r(t.sf(2.0, 10)), r(t.pdf(0, 5)), r(t.ppf(0.975, 29)))
print(r(chi2.cdf(3.84, 1)), r(chi2.ppf(0.95, 1)), r(chi2.sf(10, 4)), r(chi2.ppf(0.95, 10)), r(chi2.pdf(2, 3)))
print(r(f.cdf(3.0, 2, 20)), r(f.ppf(0.95, 2, 20)), r(f.sf(4.0, 3, 16)))
a = np.array([5.1, 4.9, 6.2, 5.8, 6.0, 5.5, 5.3, 6.1])
b = np.array([6.4, 6.8, 7.1, 6.5, 7.0, 6.2, 6.9, 7.3])
for res in [stats.ttest_ind(a, b), stats.ttest_ind(a, b, equal_var=False), stats.ttest_1samp(a, 5.0), stats.ttest_rel(a, b), stats.ttest_ind(a, b, alternative='less')]:
    print(r(res.statistic), r(res.pvalue))
s, p = stats.ttest_ind(a, b)
print(r(s), r(p))
c = stats.chi2_contingency(np.array([[30, 10], [20, 40]]))
print(r(c.statistic), r(c.pvalue), c.dof, np.round(c.expected_freq, 3))
